'''krazy_cheetah Stepping Up''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[krazy_cheetah]]
* '''Published:''' 2 March 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|An Unusual Amount Of Fear|Ref3-L-anunusualamountoffear.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 WYS krazy cheetah LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Luke Skywalker (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

This is a new deck 1st build of WYS and I am looking for some tips.

The published list has 61 cards.

== Notes ==

* Qty 61 as published (no section counts are given).
* Original-era (V): Luke Skywalker (V) (Virtual Set 1).
* Posted 'Wedge Antilles' dested the A New Hope Wedge Antilles; 'Han w/ Blaster' Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Tatooine (Coruscant)' the Coruscant-set Tatooine system (same title); 'X-wing Laser Cannons' X-wing Laser Cannon.

== Strategy ==

Ok this deck is all about avoidance and drains and if I do battle it is usually huge in my favor but I do struggle sometimes and am looking for some advice on it. It is really basic I pull Kessel and my docking bay turn 1 then I deploy my freighters to Spaceport Docking Bay and go to Tatooine or Kessel and drain while avoiding battle on the ground. I do have the 3 epps in the deck if I do need to battle. Any help would be great. Thanks
